excerpt.zh: 我们的特工盯上了一位长期热衷于公开批判帝国的特使，并着手处理这危险的星星之火。
excerpt.en: Our operatives are shadowing an envoy that has long been an outspoken critic of the Imperium. Work is underway to deal with this dangerous firebrand.
